notes.title: UD2 Patch Notes: Release Week!
notes.content:
[h1]Always Improving[/h1][p]The launch of Unseen Diplomacy 2 is an incredible milestone, and we’ll love seeing so many of you dive, crawl, and sneak your way through missions. While the game is already complete and fully playable, Early Access gives us the chance to refine it further - polishing mechanics, balancing gadgets, improving accessibility, and of course adding new content.
[/p][h1]Our Roadmap[/h1][p]
We’re constantly working on fixes and improvements, from adding more locomotion features and refining visual effects, to adding more music, missions, and MR content. Some of these things have already landed in updates, while others are still on the way.
If you’d like to follow along, we’ve made our development roadmap public:
 👉 [url="https://trello.com/b/SND1cf20/unseen-diplomacy-2" style="button"]Unseen Diplomacy 2 Roadmap[/url] - [url="https://trello.com/b/SND1cf20/unseen-diplomacy-2"]https://trello.com/b/SND1cf20/unseen-diplomacy-2[/url]
[/p][h1]And Join the Conversation[/h1][p]
Early Access is about building the best version of Unseen Diplomacy 2 together. We’d love to hear your ideas, suggestions, or feedback on what you’d like to see improved or added. Whether it’s a tweak to gadgets, accessibility options, or dream spy missions, your input helps shape the future of the game. 
Join us on our [url="https://discord.gg/VzhNeZGxpv" style="button"]Discord![/url] - [url="https://discord.gg/VzhNeZGxpv"]https://discord.gg/VzhNeZGxpv[/url] 

We’re proud of what’s already here, and we’re excited about what’s still to come. Thank you for being part of this adventure so far  - and looking forward to you helping us refine Unseen Diplomacy 2 into the ultimate spy experience.
[/p]

notes.title: Unseen Diplomacy 2 Launches in Early Access on September 25
notes.content: [p][b]Bude, United Kingdom - September 19th, 2025[/b] - [b]Triangular Pixels [/b]are excited to announce that [b][i]Unseen Diplomacy 2[/i][/b], the follow up to their acclaimed espionage VR experience, will launch in Meta and Steam Early Access on September 25th. The Early Access period will give players the first opportunity to step into the shadows and share their feedback while the studio continues refining, polishing, and expanding the experience to ensure the most immersive spy experience possible.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/DzH7XadfNhE"]View the video here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]The game is complete! But Triangular Pixels has decided to launch [i]Unseen Diplomacy 2[/i] in Early Access to gather community feedback, refine mechanics, balance difficulty, and polish the experience across different playstyles and spaces. The Early Access period is expected to last a short time, with the 1.0 launch expanding the game with more missions, multiple endings, and varied challenges, along with improvements to accessibility, performance and balance. Throughout development, the team will actively involve the community to help them shape updates and future content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635892/ce354eea70ef2b277a2d045e51c4f508892e0e87.png"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Unseen Diplomacy 2[/i], players take on the role of a spymaster, leading their own elite agency while also getting their hands dirty out in the field in a 1990s inspired retro-futuristic setting with analog technology. Sneak around enemy bases to steal valuable intel and resources, sabotage their plans, and then successfully escape without being noticed. To fully immerse themselves into this role, players will physically crawl, roll under lasers, and dodge side to side while utilizing new gadgets, like the wire clippers, and wearing disguises to dupe the enemy. Those who prefer a less quiet approach can also utilize blow darts. To ensure every mission and campaign feels fresh, Triangular Pixels uses a new system that not only procedurally generates levels, but also tailors the experience based on the space you have and the actions you take.[/p][p][/p][p]Beyond the thrilling action, the spymaster’s job is to also manage the agency, adding a strategic layer to the game. Players recruit agents, manage resources, and deploy operatives on high-stakes missions to thwart rogue corporations, mad scientists and secret organizations threatening global stability. Every mission will bring you closer to uncovering the truth, and depending on the choices the players make, the road to success varies from playthrough to playthrough.[/p][p][/p][p]“We’re so proud of how far [i]Unseen Diplomacy 2[/i] has come, but we want to make sure to give players the best, most polished experience we can,” said Katie Goode at Triangular Pixels. “Launching the game in Early Access gives us the chance to share the game with our community sooner, gather feedback, and keep making it bigger and more immersive as we move towards full release.”[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635892/6ece1275d068204afd469ba72b2a78f517f5b4a8.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]Key features:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]High-stakes operations[/b]: utilize stealth, strategy, and quick thinking to steal assets, gather evidence, sabotage obstacles that will slice, dice, zap, crush, burn or call the guards, and escape unseen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic and replayable missions[/b]: every playthrough is unique, with missions providing fresh challenges. You can play through the Campaign or hop into Quick Play to do your daily exercise [/p][/*][*][p][b]New  gameplay mechanics[/b]: in addition to the locomotion-based stealth, the game features clipping and rerouting wires, hacking computer terminals, enemy robots, disguises, photography, and shooting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strategic spymaster gameplay[/b]: manage your agency, recruit agents, and deploy them on missions to gather intel and outmaneuver enemy counterspies[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Director Graph System[/b]: developed by Triangular Pixels, this system allows for generating dynamic, procedural levels that adapt to the play area, hardware, difficulty settings and gameplay preferences, as well as making the process of creating content much easier and allowing level designers to hand craft the flow of levels[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mixed reality integration[/b]: Meta Quest 3 players will be able to experience the spy world in their living space, blending the virtual with the real world.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessibility[/b]: The game comes with new support for those with tremors, one handed play, difficulty control and also supports those needing standing and seated play.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]About Triangular Pixels[/b][/p][p]Triangular Pixels is a BAFTA nominated Cornish independent games studio, founded over 10 years ago by ex-Sony London Studio developers. Triangular Pixels has a passion for fun, light hearted, and manic gaming that is fun to share. They have previously released [i]Unseen Diplomacy [/i]and [i]Smash Hit Plunder[/i], and collaborated on projects with other developers like XR Games, Vive and Ramen VR. Triangular Pixels also developed VR tools such as Technie Collider Creator, Technie Virtual Console, and Technie Scene Palette.[/p]
